source.title: An Earnest Proposition
source.description:
Hail, <class>!  I can tell by your demeanor that you've seen and done much in this world.  Yet I'm willing to wager you haven't seen a piece of armor like this.

Perform a small favor for me and I'll be willing to trade it to you for an ordinary set of bracers.

I'm in need of a sizeable sample of venom drawn from the spiders and scorpions that inhabit Silithus.  Bring this to me along with a few gold coins and I'll perform the exchange.
source.objective: Acquire 15 Silithus Venom Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Devout Bracers to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
source.progress: Have you obtained the items I require, <name>?
source.completion:
Ah, yes.  Mux will be quite happy with this.

Those bracers were part of a larger armor set.  If you're interested in providing me with further assistance,  I'd be willing to consider parting with the rest of it.
